## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- Tested commit SHA:
- Commands and results:
- Independent agent (not the implementer):
- Independent PASS/FAIL, findings and corrective verification:

## Integration

- [ ] Work branch originated from develop.
- [ ] Independent agent passed the final implementation and CI is green.
- [ ] Commits are thematic; local plans, audit output, caches and large files are excluded.
- [ ] PR targets develop, or is a release/vX.Y.Z PR targeting main.
- [ ] For release: package version matches X.Y.Z and the merged main commit will receive vX.Y.Z.
